metadata.description: Agent skills from Precedent Labs: reusable workflows distilled from real sessions.

plugins.name: develop-loop
plugins.description: Develop loop for all implementation work: triage selects the next batch of findings to fix, an implement → review → fix loop runs every change until clean, and a model-tiered fanout does the work with the cheapest adequate model per task.

plugins.name: optimization
plugins.description: Metric-driven optimization loop: profile, one change at a time, measure, accept or reject, regression gate, develop-loop review, record. Goal is given on the command line.
